description: This PHP class 'reqSpecCommands' manages requirement specifications within a testing project, including creation, editing, deletion, reordering, copying, freezing, revision handling, file uploads, and bulk monitoring. It interacts with requirement managers, requirement spec managers, and system configurations, and provides GUI initialization and processing functions.

classes.name: reqSpecCommands
classes.description: A class providing comprehensive management of requirement specifications, including CRUD operations, revisions, copying, reordering, freezing, file handling, and bulk monitoring within a test management system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the reqSpecCommands object, setting up database connections, requirement managers, and system configurations based on project ID.

methods.name: setAuditContext
methods.description: Sets the audit context for logging purposes.

methods.name: getReqMgrSystem
methods.description: Returns the linked requirement management system.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes a GUI object with default properties for requirement spec management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for creating a new requirement specification.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for editing an existing requirement specification.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new requirement specification, including database insertion and logging.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Processes updates to an existing requirement specification, including validation and revision handling.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a requirement specification and logs the event.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Prepares GUI for reordering requirement specifications.

methods.name: doReorder
methods.description: Executes reordering of requirement specifications based on user input.

methods.name: createChild
methods.description: Prepares GUI for creating a child requirement specification.

methods.name: copyRequirements
methods.description: Prepares GUI for copying multiple requirements from a specification.

methods.name: doCopyRequirements
methods.description: Performs copying of selected requirements to another location.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Prepares GUI for copying a requirement specification.

methods.name: doCopy
methods.description: Executes copying of a requirement specification.

methods.name: doFreeze
methods.description: Freezes a requirement specification and its child nodes, including associated requirements.

methods.name: simpleCompare
methods.description: Compares old and new requirement specifications and custom fields to determine changes and revision suggestions.

methods.name: doCreateRevision
methods.description: Creates a new revision of a requirement specification.

methods.name: process_revision
methods.description: Handles the process of updating or creating a revision, including validation, user prompts, and database updates.

methods.name: fileUpload
methods.description: Handles uploading files attached to requirement specifications.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes an attached file from a requirement specification.

methods.name: initGuiObjForAttachmentOperations
methods.description: Initializes GUI object for attachment upload or deletion operations.

methods.name: bulkReqMon
methods.description: Prepares GUI for bulk monitoring of requirements.

methods.name: doBulkReqMon
methods.description: Performs bulk monitoring actions (start, stop, toggle) on requirements.
